name: [Platform] 02 Intelligent Model Router

assignments.name: system_prompt
assignments.value: ={{ $json.system_prompt || "You are a careful, factual assistant. If you are not certain, say so explicitly." }}

parameters.content:
## Reusable platform service: LLM Model Router

Called by the domain workflows with **Execute Sub-workflow**.

**Input** `task_type` (research | reasoning | extraction | verification | classification | summarization | code | conversation | general), `objective` (cost | balanced | quality | latency), `privacy` (standard | sensitive | local_only), `input`, `system_prompt`, `force_provider`, `caller`.

**Output** `ok`, `status`, `output`, `selected_provider`, `selected_model`, `reason`, `fallback_used`, `latency_ms` (MEASURED), `estimated.cost_usd` (ESTIMATE), `candidate_scores[]`, `policy_flags[]`.

## Deterministic selection, not an LLM guessing

Hard gates first (privacy locality, JSON-mode capability, minimum quality, context size), then a weighted score over quality prior, blended token price and latency prior.

`privacy=local_only` is **refused**, not silently downgraded to a cloud provider, when no local candidate is registered.

Registry prices and quality priors are configured values, not measurements. Measured latency is captured per call into the `agentic_router_telemetry` data table.

## Reliability

Each provider call retries 3x with a 2s backoff, then routes its **error output** to a different vendor (Gemini Flash Lite), so a single provider outage degrades instead of failing.

The fallback itself uses `continueRegularOutput`, so even a total outage returns a structured `status: "failed"` envelope rather than crashing the caller.

activeVersion.name: Raise output token budgets to stop truncated JSON
activeVersion.description: Two callers (01 API integration and 06 financial documents) independently produced JSON that ended mid-object. Both current-generation models spend part of the output budget on reasoning tokens, so a 2048 cap was cutting the visible answer short. Raised Gemini to 8192 output tokens and set an explicit 8192 cap on OpenAI and Anthropic.
